FM15.reasoning: The agent only computes and reports the primary RMSLE metric, without tracking secondary metrics like MAE or RMSE that could provide additional context on model performance and outlier handling.

other_failure_modes.name: ignoring_test_ids
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates artificial submission IDs using a simple range (`np.arange`) instead of passing through the original identifier column from the test dataset. This will cause the submission file to have misaligned or incorrect IDs, leading to an evaluation failure.

summary: The agent successfully implements a robust time-series forecasting solution with proper temporal cross-validation, useful derived features, and appropriate log-transformations for the RMSLE objective. However, a critical flaw exists in the final submission formatting: it hardcodes the submission IDs from zero instead of using the actual test set IDs, which invalidates the submission file format.
